goal.en: Get student tickets and an audio guide, and find out the museum's photo rules.
goal.zh: 買到學生票和語音導覽，並問清楚博物館的拍照規定。

background: maritime museum hall, large wooden ship model in a glass case, brass ship wheel on display, rope barriers, high ceiling with skylight, polished wooden floor, rainy afternoon light

intro.en: After lunch, it starts to rain, so the three of you run into the Port Aurora Maritime Museum.
intro.zh: 午餐後下起雨來，你們三個跑進了極光港海事博物館。

intro.en: Perfect timing. I love old ships!
intro.zh: 時機剛好。我超愛古老的船！

lines.en: Welcome to the Maritime Museum! Adult tickets are $18 each.
lines.zh: 歡迎來到海事博物館！全票一張 18 元。

choices.en: Hi! Is there a discount for students?
choices.zh: 你好！請問有學生優惠嗎？
choices.tip: Is there a discount for...? 是禮貌詢問優惠的標準句型。

choices.en: We are student. Can cheaper a little?
choices.zh: 我們是學生。可以便宜一點嗎？

lines.en: Cheaper a little...? I'm sorry, dear, I don't quite follow.
lines.zh: 便宜一點點……？抱歉，親愛的，我不太懂。

story.en: Ruth isn't sure what you mean, so she smiles and sells you three adult tickets.
story.zh: 露絲不確定你的意思，就微笑著賣給你們三張全票。

fail.why: 「可以便宜一點嗎」直譯成 Can cheaper a little? 缺少主詞和動詞，對方很難懂。問學生優惠要說 Is there a discount for students?

choices.en: Eighteen? That's too expensive. Give us the student price.
choices.zh: 18 元？太貴了吧。給我們學生價。

lines.en: Well. The money keeps these old ships alive, you know.
lines.zh: 這個嘛，這些錢是用來維護這些老船的喔。

story.en: You do get the student price, along with a fifteen-minute talk about how much it costs to repair a 200-year-old ship.
story.zh: 你拿到了學生價，外加十五分鐘的講解，關於修一艘兩百年老船要花多少錢。

fail.why: 直接嫌貴再命令對方給學生價，聽起來很沒禮貌。想問優惠就說 Is there a discount for students?

lines.en: Yes, students pay $10. Would you like an audio guide? It's $4 extra.
lines.zh: 有，學生票 10 元。要加購語音導覽嗎？多 4 元。

choices.en: Yes, please. Is it available in Chinese?
choices.zh: 好，麻煩了。有中文版的嗎？
choices.tip: Is it available in + 語言？ 用來問有沒有某種語言的版本。

choices.en: No, thanks. We can hear very well.
choices.zh: 不用了，謝謝。我們聽力很好。

lines.en: Oh, it's not for hearing, dear. It tells you about the ships!
lines.zh: 喔，那不是助聽器啦，親愛的。它會介紹這些船！

story.en: By the time you understand, Ruth is busy with the next visitor. You walk past forty ships with no idea what any of them are.
story.zh: 等你搞懂時，露絲已經在招呼下一位客人。你們走過四十艘船，完全不知道它們是什麼。

fail.why: audio guide 是「語音導覽」，用耳機聽展品介紹，不是助聽器。想要就說 Yes, please. Is it available in Chinese?

choices.en: Yes, please. Does it has a Chinese version too?
choices.zh: 好，麻煩了。它也有中文版嗎？

lines.en: Does it has...? Sorry, here's the English one, dear.
lines.zh: 它有……？抱歉，先給你英文版吧，親愛的。

story.en: The English guide talks about "the forecastle" and "the bilge" for two hours. You understand three words.
story.zh: 英文導覽講了兩個小時的「艏樓」和「艙底」。你只聽懂三個字。

fail.why: does 後面的動詞要用原形，所以是 Does it have...?，不是 Does it has...?。也可以說 Is it available in Chinese?

lines.en: Kai, look at this ship model! I want a photo, but is it okay?
lines.zh: 凱，你看這個船模型！我想拍照，可是可以拍嗎？

lines.en: Beautiful, isn't it? That model is over two hundred years old.
lines.zh: 很漂亮吧？那個模型已經超過兩百年了。

choices.en: It's amazing. Are we allowed to take photos here?
choices.zh: 太厲害了。請問這裡可以拍照嗎？
choices.tip: Are we allowed to...? 用來問規定允不允許，清楚又有禮貌。

choices.en: It's amazing. I'll just take a quick flash photo.
choices.zh: 太厲害了。我拍一張閃光燈照片就好。

lines.en: No flash, please! It damages the old paint.
lines.zh: 請不要用閃光燈！會傷到老舊的漆。

story.en: The flash goes off, and every guard in the room turns around. You spend the next hour feeling very watched.
story.zh: 閃光燈一閃，整間展廳的警衛都轉過頭來。接下來一小時，你都覺得被緊盯著。

fail.why: 很多博物館禁止閃光燈，因為強光會傷害古老的展品。拍照前先問 Are we allowed to take photos here?

choices.en: Here can take photo or cannot?

lines.en: Here can...? Oh, the restroom? It's down the hall, dear.
lines.zh: 這裡可以……？喔，洗手間嗎？在走廊盡頭，親愛的。

story.en: Ruth kindly walks you all the way to the restroom. Mia takes no photos.
story.zh: 露絲好心地一路帶你到洗手間。米亞一張照片也沒拍到。

fail.why: 「可不可以」直譯成 can or cannot，加上缺少主詞，英文聽不懂。要說 Are we allowed to take photos here? 或 Can we take photos here?

lines.en: Photos are fine, just no flash. You know, my grandfather sailed on that ship.
lines.zh: 可以拍照，只是不能用閃光燈。跟你說，我祖父當年就在那艘船上航行。

choices.en: Really? What was his job on the ship?
choices.zh: 真的嗎？他在船上做什麼工作？
choices.tip: 對方分享個人故事時，用 What was...? 追問，表示你真的有興趣。

choices.en: Oh. Okay. Anyway, where's the gift shop?
choices.zh: 喔，好。總之，紀念品店在哪？

lines.en: Down the hall, on the left.

story.en: You find the gift shop, but you never hear the best story in the whole museum.
story.zh: 你找到了紀念品店，卻錯過了整間博物館最精彩的故事。

fail.why: 對方分享家族故事時，用 Anyway 直接轉話題會顯得冷淡。先回應再追問：Really? What was his job on the ship?

choices.en: Really? Your grandfather was work on this ship?
choices.zh: 真的嗎？你祖父是在這艘船上工作？

lines.en: Was work...? Well, he worked on it, yes. Sorry, what was the question?
lines.zh: 是工作……？嗯，他是在船上工作沒錯。抱歉，你剛剛問什麼？

story.en: The conversation drifts away, and Ruth goes back to her desk. Mia whispers that she really wanted to hear more.
story.zh: 話題漂走了，露絲回到她的櫃檯。米亞小聲說她其實很想多聽一點。

fail.why: was 後面不能接原形動詞 work。過去式直接說 He worked on this ship?，或用問句 What was his job on the ship?

lines.en: He was the ship's cook! Come, I'll show you his old photo.
lines.zh: 他是船上的廚師！來，我帶你們看他的老照片。

lines.en: Best museum ever. And no flash, I promise!
lines.zh: 史上最棒的博物館。而且我保證不開閃光燈！

story.en: Ruth shows you a faded photo of a smiling young cook on the deck. Some stories aren't on the audio guide.
story.zh: 露絲讓你們看一張褪色照片，甲板上有位年輕廚師笑得燦爛。有些故事，語音導覽裡聽不到。

notes.en: Is there a discount for students?
notes.explain: 禮貌詢問優惠的標準句型，也可以問 Is there a student discount?。記得準備學生證（student ID）。

example.en: Is there a discount for groups of three or more?
example.zh: 三人以上有團體優惠嗎？

notes.explain: 博物館出借的耳機導覽設備，不是助聽器（hearing aid）。問語言版本用 Is it available in Chinese?

example.en: Two audio guides, please. Is there one in Chinese?
example.zh: 麻煩兩台語音導覽。有中文的嗎？

notes.en: Are we allowed to take photos?
notes.explain: be allowed to + 原形動詞，用來問「規定上允許嗎」。單數說 Am I allowed to...?，比 Can I...? 更像在問規定。

example.en: Am I allowed to bring my umbrella inside?
example.zh: 我可以把雨傘帶進去嗎？

notes.explain: 很多博物館允許拍照，但禁止閃光燈和觸摸玻璃或展品。不確定時先問工作人員，比事後被提醒好。

example.en: Is it okay to take photos without flash?
example.zh: 不開閃光燈可以拍照嗎？

notes.explain: does 後面的動詞一律用原形：Does it have...?，不是 Does it has...?。同理 Did he work...?，不是 Was he work...?

example.en: Does the museum have a café?
